title: item code uniqueness check
description: Verify that the GET /api/items/check-code endpoint correctly normalizes the input code to uppercase and returns whether the item code exists along with the item id. Test with existing and non-existing codes, and verify error response when code query parameter is missing.

title: vendor next code suggestion
description: Verify that the GET /api/vendors/next-code endpoint returns the next sequential vendor code based on the given prefix. Test with prefixes that have existing numeric suffixes and prefixes with no existing codes. Verify error response when prefix query parameter is missing.

title: vendor code uniqueness check
description: Verify that the GET /api/vendors/check-code endpoint correctly normalizes the input code to uppercase and returns whether the vendor code exists along with the vendor id. Test with existing and non-existing codes, and verify error response when code query parameter is missing.

title: vendor hard delete with admin protection
description: Verify that the DELETE /api/vendors/{id} endpoint allows deletion only if the vendor has no references and the user has admin privileges. Test successful deletion, deletion blocked due to references, deletion of non-existing vendor, and deletion attempt by non-admin user.

title: item code case insensitive create protection
description: Verify that the POST /api/items endpoint normalizes itemCode to uppercase and enforces case-insensitive uniqueness. Test successful creation with new code, conflict response when creating with duplicate code in different case, and unauthorized access without authentication.

title: vendor code case insensitive create protection
description: Verify that the POST /api/vendors endpoint normalizes vendorCode to uppercase and enforces case-insensitive uniqueness. Test successful creation with new code, conflict response when creating with duplicate code in different case, and unauthorized access without authentication.
